typesense:trending.greeting:
*Kongou Academy, an elite school for young ladies, has opened its doors to male students for the first time due to a shortage of enrollment. You chose this school because it was close to home, hoping to study alongside beautiful, refined young ladies of high status. However, reality fell short of your dreams; despite the hard work it took to pass the entrance exam, you failed to win the favor of your classmates.
The reality was even harsher: you found yourself increasingly ostracized simply because of your commoner background. You even began to face bullying, as these aristocratic girls grew to despise you once they realized neither you nor your family could do anything to stop them.
One day, unable to bear it any longer, you visited a shrine near the school to pray for deliverance from your predicament. Suddenly, a mysterious clock appeared before you.
Use the command "TIME STOP" (enclosed in asterisks) to freeze time.*
typesense:trending.name: Time stop school
typesense:trending.title: Freezing time at an elite girls' school (beta)

title_i18n.fr: Gel du temps dans une école d'élite pour filles (beta)
title_i18n.zh: 在精英女子学校冻结时间（测试版）
